CHAP USTUN:
29) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Fill in am, is, are, do, does or isn't, then listen and check your answers. Name the tenses of the verbs (1 - 19), then explain their uses.' A va B (Rosa) o'rtasidagi dialog, 19 ta nuqtali joy.

Ikkita kvadrat katakcha: a - 'welcoming a new teacher to a school'; b - 'welcoming a friend to a party'. Ostida ikkita och yashil yirtilgan qog'oz shaklidagi dialog (1 va 2).
• To'q sariq 'Pronunciation' sarlavhasi.
31) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen and circle the odd word out. Listen again and repeat.' Ikki ustunda 6 qator, har qatorda uchta so'z: 1 where/wear/we're; 2 she/sea/see; 3 hair/hear/here; 4 know/no/now; 5 been/bin/bean; 6 dear/deer/dare.

O'NG USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing' sarlavhasi va yonida qora yozuv '(an article about a country and its people)'.
• To'q sariq ramkali quti - maqola yozish qoidasi (qalin harflar bilan ajratilgan iboralar).

33) 'Use the information from Ex. 32, and the plan below, to complete the article in the Photo File section about Spain and its people for a travel magazine (100 - 150 words). Use the text in Ex. 8 as a model.'
• Spiralli daftar shaklidagi ramkada REJA: Plan - Introduction (Para 1), Main Body (Para 2-5), Conclusion (Para 6).
• Katta to'q sariq 'Words of Wisdom' sarlavhasi: 'Read this sentence. What does it mean?' Ramkada: 'Honesty is the best policy.'

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in am, is, are, do, does or isn't, then listen and check your answers. Name the tenses of the verbs (1 - 19), then explain their uses.
exercises.instructionUz: am, is, are, do, does yoki isn't ni qo'ying, so'ng tinglang va javoblaringizni tekshiring. Fe'llarning zamonini ayting (1 - 19), so'ng qo'llanishini tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
ROSA - LISSABONLIK AKTRISA.

  U Britaniyada Royal Theatre Company
  bilan ishlaydi.


⚠ QAYSI YoRDAMChI QAChON:

  AM / IS / ARE ishlatiladi:
     a) 'to be' fe'li o'zi
        'I AM an actress.'
     b) PRESENT CONTINUOUS uchun
        'I AM working.'

  DO / DOES ishlatiladi:
     PRESENT SIMPLE ning so'roq va
     inkor shakli uchun
        'What DO you do?'
        'The sun DOES not shine.'

  ⚠ 'do' - I/you/we/they bilan
  ⚠ 'does' - he/she/it bilan


⚠ ENG QIYIN JOY - 11 va 12-BANDLAR:

  '11) not like the food'
     ega 'I' → DO
  'the sun 12) not shine'
     ega 'the sun' (= it) → DOES

  ⚠ Ikki qatorda ketma-ket kelgan,
  ataylab: ega o'zgarsa yordamchi ham
  o'zgaradi.


⚠ 10-BAND - 'ISN'T':

  'London 10) like Lisbon at all!'
  = London Lissabonga umuman
    o'xshamaydi.

  ⚠ 'like' bu yerda FE'L emas, PREDLOG
  ('... kabi'). Shuning uchun 'doesn't'
  emas, 'ISN'T'.

  ⚠ 'not ... at all' = umuman emas.


⚠ 19-BAND:

  'Next year we 19) travelling to
   Canada.'
  → ARE (present continuous, kelasi
    zamon ma'nosida)

  ⚠ 'Next year' bo'lsa ham fe'l HOZIRGI
  zamonda - bu 21-mashqning 'd'
  qo'llanishi.


⚠ 'AN ACTRESS':

  an actor  - erkak aktyor
  an actress - ayol aktrisa

  ⚠ Hozirgi ingliz tilida 'actor' ikkala
  jins uchun ham ishlatilmoqda.


⚠ 'TO TOUR':

  = gastrol qilmoq, sayohat qilmoq.
  'we are touring Britain' = Britaniya
  bo'ylab gastrolda yurgan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'to be' fe'li, ega 'you' → ARE.
⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE (holat).

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Ah, Lisbon! That 3) ___ a beautiful city. So, what 4) ___ you do, Rosa?
lines.uz: Ha, Lissabon! U go'zal shahar. Xo'sh, kasbingiz nima, Rosa?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 3: ega 'That' → IS ('to be').
⚠ 4: 'What do you do?' = kasbingiz nima?
PRESENT SIMPLE so'roq → DO.

lines.speaker: B
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Kasb 'to be' bilan aytiladi.
⚠ Artikl ShART: 'AN actress' (unli tovush).

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: And what 6) ___ you doing here in the UK?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ PRESENT CONTINUOUS: 'are' + doing.

⚠ 4 va 6-savolni SOLIShTIRING:
'what DO you do' (kasb) va
'what ARE you doing' (hozir).

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I 7) ___ working. I work with the Royal Theatre Company, and this year we 8) ___ touring Britain.
lines.uz: Ishlayapman. Royal Theatre Company bilan ishlayman va bu yil Britaniya bo'ylab gastroldamiz.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 7: PRESENT CONTINUOUS (vaqtinchalik) → AM.
⚠ 8: 'this year' - shu davrdagi ish →
CONTINUOUS → ARE.

⚠ E'tibor bering: 'I WORK with the Royal
Theatre Company' - DOIMIY ish, SIMPLE.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Tell me, Rosa, what 9) ___ you think of this country?
lines.uz: Ayting-chi, Rosa, bu mamlakat haqida nima deb o'ylaysiz?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'think' - HOLAT fe'li, CONTINUOUS bo'lmaydi
→ PRESENT SIMPLE → DO.

⚠ 'What do you think OF sth?' = ... haqida
fikringiz qanday?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Well, London 10) ___ like Lisbon at all! I 11) ___ not like the food very much and the sun 12) ___ not shine very often, but the people 13) ___ great, and I love shopping here!
lines.uz: London Lissabonga umuman o'xshamaydi! Ovqatni unchalik yoqtirmayman va quyosh ko'p chiqmaydi, lekin odamlar zo'r va bu yerda xarid qilishni yaxshi ko'raman!
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 10: 'like' bu yerda PREDLOG ('... kabi'),
fe'l emas → 'to be' inkori → ISN'T.
⚠ 11: ega 'I' → DO (not).
⚠ 12: ega 'the sun' (= it) → DOES (not).
⚠ 13: ega 'the people' - KO'PLIK → ARE.

⚠ 11 va 12 ataylab yonma-yon: ega o'zgarsa
yordamchi ham o'zgaradi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I 15) ___ seeing my friends this evening. We 16) ___ going to the theatre.
lines.uz: Bugun kechqurun do'stlarim bilan ko'rishaman. Teatrga boramiz.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Ikkalasi ham YAQIN KELAJAKDAGI REJA →
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

⚠ 'see' bu yerda 'uchrashmoq' ma'nosida -
shuning uchun continuous mumkin ('ko'rmoq'
ma'nosida bo'lganda mumkin emas).

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: 17) ___ you travel to other countries, too?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ ODAT haqida savol → PRESENT SIMPLE → DO.
⚠ Gap boshida bo'lgani uchun KATTA harf.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, we 18) ___ . Next year we 19) ___ travelling to Canada. I can't wait!
lines.uz: Ha. Kelasi yili Kanadaga safar qilamiz. Sabrim chidamayapti!
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 18: qisqa javob - savoldagi yordamchi
takrorlanadi → DO.
⚠ 19: 'Next year' bo'lsa ham CONTINUOUS -
aniq reja.

⚠ "I can't wait!" = sabrsizlik bilan kutyapman.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the dialogues and match them to the situations in the list below. Then, in pairs, act out the dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialoglarni tinglang va quyidagi ro'yxatdagi vaziyatlarga moslang. So'ng juftlikda dialoglarni ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI DIALOG, IKKI VAZIYaT.

  ⚠ Javobni MATNDAN ham topish mumkin -
  audio faqat tekshirish uchun.


1-DIALOG (to'liq matni):

  A: Hi, John! Come on in! Oh, by the
     way, this is Carol. Carol, do you
     know John?
  C: No. Nice to meet you, John.
  J: Hello, Carol. Nice to meet you, too.

  ⚠ 'Come on in!' - uyga taklif.
  ⚠ Demak bu - BAZM (party).


2-DIALOG (to'liq matni):

  S: Hello there! I'm Susan Lloyd. You
     must be Don Brown. Welcome to
     St Mary's!
  D: Thanks. Um, I'm sorry, I didn't
     catch your name.
  S: Susan, Susan Lloyd.
  D: Hi, Susan. I'm glad to meet you.

  ⚠ "St Mary's" - MAKTAB nomi.
  ⚠ Demak bu - yangi O'QITUVChINI
  kutib olish.


⚠ RASMIY VA NORASMIY FARQI:

  NORASMIY (1-dialog):
     Hi! · Come on in! · by the way

  RASMIYROQ (2-dialog):
     Hello there! · Welcome to ...
     I'm glad to meet you.


⚠ 'YOU MUST BE ...':

  = siz ... bo'lsangiz kerak.
  ⚠ 'must' bu yerda MAJBURIYaT emas,
  TAXMIN bildiradi (aniqlik).

  ⚠ Bu - 24-25-betdagi hikoyaning
  grammatika mavzusi.


⚠ "I DIDN'T CATCH YOUR NAME":

  = ismingizni eshitolmadim.
  ⚠ 'to catch' bu yerda 'eshitib
  ulgurmoq' ma'nosida.
  ⚠ Juda muloyim ibora - 'What?' deb
  so'rashdan ancha odobli.


⚠ 'BY THE WAY':

  = aytgancha, darvoqe.
  ⚠ Mavzuni o'zgartirishda ishlatiladi.
  ⚠ Qisqartmasi: BTW (yozishmalarda).

pairs.left: a - welcoming a new teacher to a school
pairs.right: Dialogue 2 (Susan Lloyd and Don Brown at St Mary's)
pairs.leftUz: a - maktabga yangi o'qituvchini kutib olish
pairs.rightUz: 2-dialog (Syuzan Lloyd va Don Braun St Mary's da)
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ "Welcome to ST MARY'S!" - maktab nomi.

⚠ 'You must be Don Brown' - taxmin: demak
ular birinchi marta ko'rishyapti.

pairs.left: b - welcoming a friend to a party
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'Come on in!' - uyga taklif.
⚠ 'Hi' va 'by the way' - NORASMIY nutq.

exercises.explanationUz:
KUTIB OLISh IBORALARI - YoDLASh UChUN.


TANIShTIRISh:
  This is [ism].
  Do you know [ism]?
  I'd like you to meet [ism]. (rasmiy)

TANIShGANDA:
  Nice to meet you.
  Nice to meet you, too.
  I'm glad to meet you.
  Pleased to meet you. (rasmiyroq)
  How do you do? (juda rasmiy)

KUTIB OLISh:
  Come on in!
  Welcome to [joy]!
  Make yourself at home.

ISM ESHITILMASA:
  I'm sorry, I didn't catch your name.
  Sorry, could you say that again?


⚠ 'NICE TO MEET YOU' va
  'NICE TO SEE YOU':

  MEET - BIRINChI marta
  SEE   - keyingi uchrashuvlarda

  ⚠ Bu farq juda muhim: eski tanishga
  'Nice to meet you' desangiz, uni
  unutganingiz bilinadi.


⚠ 'HOW DO YOU DO?':

  ⚠ Bu SAVOL EMAS! Javobi ham
  'How do you do?' bo'ladi.
  ⚠ Juda rasmiy va eskirgan.

points.en: A: Hi, John! Come on in! Oh, by the way, this is Carol. Carol, do you know John?
points.uz: A: Salom, Jon! Kiraver! Aytgancha, bu Kerol. Kerol, Jonni bilasanmi?
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Come on in!' - 'Come in!' ning samimiy shakli.
⚠ 'by the way' = aytgancha, darvoqe.
⚠ 'This is ...' - odamni tanishtirish qolipi.

points.en: C: No. Nice to meet you, John.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Nice to MEET you' - BIRINChI uchrashuvda.
⚠ To'liq shakli: 'It's nice to meet you.'

points.en: J: Hello, Carol. Nice to meet you, too.
points.uz: J: Salom, Kerol. Men ham tanishganimdan xursandman.

points.en: S: Hello there! I'm Susan Lloyd. You must be Don Brown. Welcome to St Mary's!
points.uz: S: Assalomu alaykum! Men Syuzan Lloydman. Siz Don Braun bo'lsangiz kerak. St Mary'sga xush kelibsiz!
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Hello there!' - samimiy, lekin 'Hi' dan
rasmiyroq.
⚠ 'You MUST be ...' - 'must' TAXMIN bildiradi,
majburiyat emas.
⚠ 'Welcome TO [joy]' - predlog 'to'.

points.en: D: Thanks. Um, I'm sorry, I didn't catch your name.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Um' - o'ylanish tovushi (o'zbekchada 'e-e').
⚠ "I didn't catch your name" - juda muloyim
ibora, 'What?' dan ancha odobli.

⚠ Ism takrorlanadi: avval ism, keyin to'liq
ism-familiya.

points.en: D: Hi, Susan. I'm glad to meet you.
points.noteUz:
⚠ "I'm glad to meet you" = 'Nice to meet you'
bilan bir xil ma'no, biroz iliqroq.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and circle the odd word out. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va ortiqcha so'zni aylantiring. Yana tinglang va takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'ShASh TOVUShLAR (similar sounds).

  ⚠ Har qatorda uchta so'z: IKKITASI
  bir xil o'qiladi, BITTASI boshqacha.

  ⚠ Bu so'zlar 'homophones' deb ataladi:
  imlosi boshqa, talaffuzi bir xil.


TO'LIQ TAHLIL:

  1  where /weə/ · wear /weə/ ·
     we're /wɪə/
     → ortiqcha: WE'RE
     ⚠ "we're" = 'we are'

  2  she /ʃiː/ · sea /siː/ · see /siː/
     → ortiqcha: SHE
     ⚠ 'sh' va 's' - boshqa tovush

  3  hair /heə/ · hear /hɪə/ · here /hɪə/
     → ortiqcha: HAIR
     ⚠ 'hear' (eshitmoq) va 'here' (bu
     yerda) bir xil o'qiladi

  4  know /nəʊ/ · no /nəʊ/ · now /naʊ/
     → ortiqcha: NOW
     ⚠ 'know' da 'k' O'QILMAYDI

  5  been /biːn/ · bin /bɪn/ · bean /biːn/
     → ortiqcha: BIN
     ⚠ /iː/ uzun, /ɪ/ qisqa

  6  dear /dɪə/ · deer /dɪə/ · dare /deə/
     → ortiqcha: DARE
     ⚠ 'dear' (aziz) va 'deer' (kiyik)
     bir xil


⚠ IKKI QIYIN JUFTLIK:

  /ɪə/ (i-e): here, hear, dear, deer,
              we're
  /eə/ (e-e): hair, where, wear, dare

  ⚠ O'zbek qulog'iga ikkalasi ham
  'ie' bo'lib eshitiladi - shuning
  uchun ataylab qarshi qo'yilgan.


⚠ /iː/ va /ɪ/ - UZUN VA QISQA:

  been, bean /iː/ - UZUN
  bin /ɪ/ - QISQA

  ⚠ Yana: sheep/ship, seat/sit,
  feel/fill, leave/live.
  ⚠ Bu farq MA'NONI o'zgartiradi!

items.whyUz:
⚠ where /weə/ va wear /weə/ - BIR XIL.
⚠ we're /wɪə/ - boshqacha.

⚠ "we're" = 'we are' qisqartmasi.

⚠ sea /siː/ va see /siː/ - BIR XIL.
⚠ she /ʃiː/ - 'sh' tovushi bilan.

⚠ 'sea' (dengiz) va 'see' (ko'rmoq) -
homofonlar.

⚠ hear /hɪə/ va here /hɪə/ - BIR XIL.
⚠ hair /heə/ - boshqacha.

⚠ 'hear' (eshitmoq) va 'here' (bu yerda) -
homofonlar.

⚠ know /nəʊ/ va no /nəʊ/ - BIR XIL.
⚠ now /naʊ/ - boshqacha.

⚠ 'know' da 'k' O'QILMAYDI - bu 2-unitning
talaffuz mavzusi ('silent letters').

⚠ been /biːn/ va bean /biːn/ - BIR XIL (uzun).
⚠ bin /bɪn/ - QISQA unli.

⚠ 'a bin' = axlat qutisi; 'a bean' = loviya.

⚠ dear /dɪə/ va deer /dɪə/ - BIR XIL.
⚠ dare /deə/ - boshqacha.

⚠ 'dear' (aziz) - xat boshida: 'Dear Mum'.
⚠ 'a deer' = kiyik (ko'plikda ham 'deer').

sections.title: Writing (an article about a country and its people)
sections.titleUz: Yozish (mamlakat va uning xalqi haqida maqola)

exercises.instructionEn: When we write an article about a country and its people, we can divide our article into six paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Mamlakat va uning xalqi haqida maqola yozganda, maqolani olti xatboshiga bo'lish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLA YoZISh QOIDASI (kitobdagi quti).


OLTI XATBOShI:

  1-xatboshi:
     mamlakat NOMI, JOYLAShUVI va
     XUSUSIYaTLARI

  2-xatboshi:
     odamlar QANDAY KO'RINADI va
     ularning XARAKTERI

  3-xatboshi:
     odamlar QAYERDA yashaydi va
     QANDAY ISh qiladi

  4-xatboshi:
     ular NIMA YEYDI

  5-xatboshi:
     BO'Sh VAQTIDA nima qiladi

  6-xatboshi (oxirgi):
     mamlakat haqida bir necha so'z
     (xulosa)

  ⚠ ZAMON: odatda PRESENT SIMPLE.


⚠ NIMA UChUN PRESENT SIMPLE:

  Maqola DOIMIY holat va ODATLAR
  haqida - o'zgarmaydigan haqiqat.

  'Thai people ARE good-looking.'
  'Most people LIVE in villages.'

  ⚠ Present continuous BO'LMAYDI:
  'Thai people are being good-looking'
  - XATO.


⚠ BU TUZILISh 7-BETDAGI MATNDA
AYNAN BOR:

  Tailand maqolasini qayta o'qing -
  har xatboshi shu rejaga tushadi.

  ⚠ Yaxshi matnni NAMUNA qilib olish -
  yozishni o'rganishning eng tez yo'li.

points.en: In the first paragraph, we include the name of the country, its location and its features.
points.uz: Birinchi xatboshida mamlakat nomini, joylashuvini va xususiyatlarini yozamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to include' = o'z ichiga olmoq.
⚠ 7-betda: 'Thailand is a beautiful country ...
just south of China.'

points.en: In the second paragraph, we write what the people look like and we describe their character.
points.uz: Ikkinchi xatboshida odamlar qanday ko'rinishini yozamiz va xarakterini tasvirlaymiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'look like' (qiyofa) va 'character' (xislat) -
ikkalasi ham shu xatboshida.

points.en: In the third paragraph, we write about where the people live and what work they do.
points.uz: Uchinchi xatboshida odamlar qayerda yashashi va qanday ish qilishi haqida yozamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 7-betda: 'Most people live in villages ...
The men work in the fields.'

points.en: In the fourth paragraph, we write about what they eat.
points.uz: To'rtinchi xatboshida ular nima yeyishi haqida yozamiz.

points.en: In the fifth paragraph, we write about what they do in their free time.
points.uz: Beshinchi xatboshida ular bo'sh vaqtida nima qilishi haqida yozamiz.

points.en: In the last paragraph we write a few words about the country. We normally use the present simple.
points.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida mamlakat haqida bir necha so'z yozamiz. Odatda present simple ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 7-betda: 'Thailand is a wonderful country ...'

⚠ 'normally' = odatda.
⚠ Maqolada PRESENT SIMPLE - chunki doimiy
haqiqat haqida.

exercises.audioRequiredUz: Qaysi so'zlar ESHITILMASLIGI faqat audiodan bilinadi - kitob bilan birga keladigan yozuv kerak.
exercises.instructionEn: Read the notes, then listen and cross out the words you don't hear. Finally, use the notes to talk about the Spanish.
exercises.instructionUz: Qaydlarni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va eshitmagan so'zlaringiz ustiga chizing. Nihoyat, qaydlardan foydalanib ispanlar haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
ISPANLAR HAQIDAGI QAYDLAR.

  ⚠ Har qatorda ortiqcha so'z(lar) bor.
  Qaysi biri ortiqchaligi FAQAT AUDIODA.

  * ⚠ Looks: black hair, brown eyes, not
    very tall - qaysi biri eshitilmaydi?
  * ⚠ Character: lively, friendly, sociable,
    lazy - qaysi biri eshitilmaydi?
  * ⚠ Dwellings: in cities in small flats,
    bungalows - qaysi biri eshitilmaydi?
  * ⚠ Jobs: work in offices, fields, shops,
    factories - qaysi biri eshitilmaydi?
  * ⚠ Food: seafood, noodles, omelettes -
    qaysi biri eshitilmaydi?
  * ⚠ Free-time Activities: going to cafes
    and clubs, going out for dinner -
    qaysi biri eshitilmaydi?


⚠ QAYD OLISh USLUBI:

  E'tibor bering: qaydlar TO'LIQ GAP
  emas - faqat kalit so'zlar.

  'black hair, brown eyes, not very tall'
  ('They have got black hair' EMAS)

  ⚠ Gapirganda ulardan to'liq gap
  tuziladi:
  'The Spanish have got black hair and
   brown eyes. They are not very tall.'


⚠ 'THE SPANISH':

  = ispan xalqi.
  ⚠ -sh bilan tugagan millat nomi
  ko'plikda O'ZGARMAYDI: the Spanish,
  the English, the British, the Irish.
  ⚠ Fe'l KO'PLIKDA: 'The Spanish ARE ...'


⚠ YANGI SO'ZLAR:

  lively    = jonli, harakatchan
  a bungalow = bir qavatli uy
  a factory = zavod, fabrika
  an omelette = omlet
  to go out for dinner = tashqarida
     ovqatlanmoq

points.en: Looks: black hair, brown eyes, not very tall
points.uz: Tashqi qiyofa: qora soch, jigarrang ko'z, unchalik baland bo'yli emas
points.noteUz:
⚠ Qaysi so'z eshitilmasligi AUDIODAN.

⚠ To'liq gap: 'They have got black hair and
brown eyes. They are not very tall.'

⚠ Qaysi so'z eshitilmasligi AUDIODAN.

⚠ 'lively' = jonli, harakatchan ('life' so'zidan).
⚠ 'lazy' - SALBIY sifat; qolgan uchtasi ijobiy.

points.en: Dwellings: in cities in small flats, bungalows
points.uz: Turar joylar: shaharlarda kichik kvartiralarda, bir qavatli uylarda
points.noteUz:

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information from Ex. 32, and the plan below, to complete the article in the Photo File section about Spain and its people for a travel magazine (100 - 150 words). Use the text in Ex. 8 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: 32-mashqdagi ma'lumot va quyidagi rejadan foydalanib, sayohat jurnali uchun Ispaniya va uning xalqi haqidagi maqolani yozing (100 - 150 so'z). 8-mashqdagi matnni namuna qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLA - LOYIHA IShI.

KITOBDAGI REJA:

  INTRODUCTION (kirish)
     Para 1: name of country, location,
             features

  MAIN BODY (asosiy qism)
     Para 2: people's looks & character
     Para 3: where people live, what
             they do
     Para 4: people's favourite foods
     Para 5: people's free-time
             activities

  CONCLUSION (xulosa)
     Para 6: comments about the country

  ⚠ Bu - HAR QANDAY maqolaning
  universal tuzilishi:
     kirish → asosiy qism → xulosa


⚠ HAJM: 100-150 SO'Z

  ⚠ Olti xatboshi uchun bu juda oz -
  har xatboshi 2-3 gapdan iborat
  bo'ladi.
  ⚠ Demak KALIT ma'lumotni tanlash
  kerak, hammasini yozish emas.


ISPANIYA HAQIDA MA'LUMOT
(32-mashqdagi qaydlardan):

  Joylashuvi: janubi-g'arbiy Yevropa
  Qiyofa: qora soch, jigarrang ko'z,
     unchalik baland emas
  Xarakter: jonli, samimiy, kirishimli
  Turar joy: shaharlarda kichik
     kvartiralarda
  Ish: idoralarda, do'konlarda,
     zavodlarda
  Ovqat: dengiz mahsulotlari, omlet
  Bo'sh vaqt: kafe va klublar,
     tashqarida ovqatlanish


⚠ 'PHOTO FILE SECTION':

  Kitobning oxiridagi suratli bo'lim.
  ⚠ U yerda maqolaning boshi berilgan,
  siz uni DAVOM ETTIRASIZ.

structure.modelEn: Spain is a beautiful country in the south-west of Europe. Its warm climate, long sandy beaches and old cities make it a perfect holiday destination.
structure.modelUz: Ispaniya - Yevropaning janubi-g'arbidagi go'zal mamlakat. Iliq iqlimi, uzun qumli plyajlari va qadimiy shaharlari uni mukammal ta'til manziliga aylantiradi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 7-betdagi Tailand matnining birinchi xatboshisi
bilan bir xil qolip.

structure.modelEn: The Spanish have got black hair and brown eyes, and they are not very tall. They are lively, friendly and very sociable people.
structure.modelUz: Ispanlarning sochi qora, ko'zlari jigarrang va ular unchalik baland bo'yli emas. Ular jonli, samimiy va juda kirishimli xalq.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 'The Spanish' - fe'l KO'PLIKDA.
⚠ 'look like' (qiyofa) va 'be like' (xarakter) -
ikkalasi ham shu xatboshida.

structure.modelEn: Most Spanish people live in cities in small flats. They work in offices, shops and factories.
structure.modelUz: Ispanlarning ko'pi shaharlarda kichik kvartiralarda yashaydi. Ular idoralarda, do'konlarda va zavodlarda ishlaydi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE - doimiy holat.
⚠ 'factorIES' - undosh + y → -ies.

structure.modelEn: Spanish food is delicious. They love eating seafood and omelettes.
structure.modelUz: Ispan taomi mazali. Ular dengiz mahsulotlari va omletni yeyishni yaxshi ko'radi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 'love' dan keyin -ING yoki 'to' + fe'l.
⚠ 'an omelette' - fransuzcha so'z.

structure.modelEn: In their free time, the Spanish enjoy going to cafes and clubs. They also like going out for dinner with friends.
structure.modelUz: Bo'sh vaqtida ispanlar kafe va klublarga borishni yoqtiradi. Yana do'stlari bilan tashqarida ovqatlanishni yaxshi ko'radi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 'to enjoy' dan keyin HAR DOIM -ING.
⚠ 'to go out for dinner' = restoranda
ovqatlanmoq.

structure.modelEn: Spain is a wonderful country. Its warm weather, beautiful cities and friendly people make it unique.
structure.modelUz: Ispaniya - ajoyib mamlakat. Iliq havosi, go'zal shaharlari va samimiy odamlari uni betakror qiladi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ Tailand matnining oxirgi gapi bilan bir xil
qolip: 'Its ... make it unique.'

⚠ 'ITS' - apostrofsiz (egalik).

exercises.instructionEn: Read this sentence. What does it mean? - Honesty is the best policy.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gapni o'qing. U nimani anglatadi? - Halollik - eng yaxshi yo'l.
exercises.explanationUz:
'HONESTY IS THE BEST POLICY.'

  So'zma-so'z: Halollik - eng yaxshi
  siyosat.

  MA'NOSI: Har doim rost gapirish
  eng foydali yo'l - yolg'on oxir-oqibat
  ochiladi va ziyon keltiradi.


⚠ O'ZBEK MUQOBILLARI:

  'Rostgo'ylik - eng katta boylik.'
  'To'g'ri so'z - toshni yoradi.'


⚠ SO'ZLAR:

  honest (sifat) = halol
  honestY (ot) = halollik
  ⚠ 'h' O'QILMAYDI: 'onist'.

  a policy = siyosat, yo'l tutish
  ⚠ 'politics' (siyosat sohasi) bilan
  ADAShTIRMANG.

  ⚠ 'the best' - 'good' sifatining
  eng yuqori darajasi:
     good → better → the best
  Bu - QOIDASIZ shakl.


⚠ NIMA UChUN BU MAQOL ShU YERDA:

  8-betdagi 14-mashqda 'honest' sifati
  bor edi: 'Tom is very honest. He never
  tells lies.'

  ⚠ Kitob so'zni MAQOL orqali
  mustahkamlaydi - maqol yaxshi esda
  qoladi, chunki u qisqa va ohangdor.


⚠ MAQOLDA ARTIKL YO'Q:

  'HonestY is the best policy.'
  ⚠ 'honesty' - MAVHUM ot, artiklsiz.

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'Practice makes
  perfect', 'Time is money'.

items.answerEn: It means that it is always better to tell the truth, because lies always come out in the end.
items.answerUz: Bu shuni anglatadiki, har doim rost gapirish yaxshiroq, chunki yolg'on oxir-oqibat baribir ochiladi.

items.en: Is there a similar saying in your language?
items.uz: Sizning tilingizda shunga o'xshash maqol bormi?
items.answerEn: Yes. In Uzbek we say: 'Rostgo'ylik - eng katta boylik.'

patterns.formula: This is [ism]. - Nice to meet you.
patterns.exampleEn: This is Carol. - Nice to meet you, Carol.
You must be Don Brown. Welcome to St Mary's!

patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'must' bu yerda TAXMIN bildiradi, majburiyat
emas.
⚠ 'Welcome TO [joy]' - predlog 'to'.

patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Juda muloyim ibora - 'What?' dan ancha odobli.
⚠ 'to catch' bu yerda 'eshitib ulgurmoq'.
